# The Trac Project

> > Open-source project management and issue tracking system with integrated wiki, roadmap planning, and version control.

Trac is a web-based software project management tool developed by Edgewall, providing developers with an integrated approach to managing software projects through TracWiki documentation, ticket tracking, and milestone planning. The platform emphasizes simplicity and extensibility for development teams.

## Getting Started

- [The Trac Project](https://trac.edgewall.org): Homepage for Trac open-source project management & issue tracking system
- [Roadmap](https://trac.edgewall.org/roadmap): Development roadmap showing Trac milestones and release planning status

## Documentation & Wiki

- [Wiki Page Template](https://trac.edgewall.org/wiki/**): Wiki page creation template with TracWiki help and extension points

## Issue Tracking & Support

- [#2656 - Make built-in documentation independent from wiki](https://trac.edgewall.org/ticket/2656): Enhancement ticket for separating Trac built-in docs from wiki system
- [#4573 - Database locked problem](https://trac.edgewall.org/ticket/4573): Closed defect ticket about SQLite database locking issues in Trac
